title: Get a licence for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's licence before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: Shire of Trayning Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2025

sources.title: Shire of Trayning Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2025
